sourceText: User (info@retiave.com), 2026-08-14: after diagnosing that root npm test / done_required fails when packages/utils/dist is absent (the recurring 'worktree needs utils build' pitfall), asked to permanently fill the gap so nobody must manually build packages/utils — '把 utils 加进...把只警告升级成自动补齐', then '那现在就开story解决'. Investigation narrowed the real gap to the root npm test path (validate never needs utils); fix is a root pretest that builds packages/main then packages/utils.
normalizedOutcome: Running npm test in a worktree where packages/utils/dist is absent now builds packages/utils (via the npm pretest lifecycle) before the full suite runs, so the suite no longer aborts with 'lattice local bootstrap is not ready / Missing build artifacts: packages/utils/dist/index.js'.
acceptanceClaim: A root pretest script builds packages/main then packages/utils before the full suite, so npm test self-bootstraps packages/utils/dist and the full suite (including bin/lattice.js sub-tests) starts without the missing-utils bootstrap failure.
